summary: Ocean Network (oncompute.ai) launched its Inference product on September 10, 2026 and is giving away 6 hours of H200 inference in complimentary tokens to mark the launch. Inference runs OpenAI-compatible models from Hugging Face Hub on dedicated node-operator GPUs with per-hour pricing shown before launch (H200 listed at $2.16/hr). Requires a funded wallet on Base — either an external wallet or the built-in Smart Wallet with email/social login and fiat on-ramp.
claim_steps: Open the Ocean Network Inference tab at dashboard.oncompute.ai/inference.
Sign in with an external wallet or the Smart Wallet (email/social login, fiat on-ramp available) on Base.
Claim the launch promo for 6 complimentary H200 hours and run a curated model, custom model, service, or template.

social_proof.title: Ocean Network Inference Is ON. Your First 6 Hours Are On Us.
social_proof.text: To mark the launch, we are giving away 6 hours of H200 inference in complimentary tokens. Claim yours and start generating.
